Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649952. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649952, standard_relation '=', and standard_value not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
